rows.name: 01. Red Alert
rows.description: The long range reconnaissance ship AFS Vasquez has failed to report in during a routine patrol of Hegemony border space. Your element will patrol the Aram sector for evidence of the missing ship.

rows.name: 02. On Wings of Thunder
rows.description: The Heracles is launching strike package Condor to take out an enemy freighter before it can leave Loris space.Your element is assigned to escort the strike package and protect it from enemy fighters.

rows.name: 03. Honor Guard
rows.description: Your element has been assigned to escort the diplomatic shuttle from Telmera Starbase to Solus orbit, and then through the Farcaster to Omane sector and Harmony Station.

rows.name: 04. A Line in the Sand
rows.description: The Hegemony is operating an illegal mining operation in the Tantalus sector of Haiche.  Your element has been tasked with destroying the support facilities for the mine.

rows.name: 05. Execution is Everything
rows.description: A group of smugglers broke out of Solus impound three days ago and reached Lornas asteroid belt this morning.  Your element is to sweep the asteroid field and find the smugglers' ship.

rows.name: 06. Supression of Enemy Air Defense
rows.description: A radical faction of the Radix Military has taken a Force recon ship and her crew hostage at a military base in the Shadow Canyon sector on Radix.  We need you to take out the SAM and AAA emplacements protecting the base.

rows.name: 07. Send Lawyers, Guns, and Money
rows.description: Your Berents-class frigate has been assigned to escort the freighters Silver Stag and Golden Hart through hostile territory.

rows.name: 08. A Matter of Focus
rows.description: An illegal drug cartel has set up major a distribution operation in the Solus system.  A major shipment is being brought in tonight.  Disable or destroy the smugglers before they can offload their cargo.

rows.name: 09. Hounds and Hunters
rows.description: An enemy destroyer squadron has broken off from the main fleet and entered the Paragon system.  Your Spectre-class Task Force must resolve this threat as quickly as possible and return to the main fleet.

rows.name: 10. Fiery the Angels Fell
rows.description: The Korian Affair has reached a crisis point.  The only hope of salvaging the treaty negotiations is for Force Second Fleet to intercept the Dantari CVBG before the Korian faction has time to react.  The CV-70 Antares and her battle group will deploy in the Korius sector and force the Dantari back to the negotiating table.

rows.name: Solus: Silent Watch
rows.description: Investigate raiders disrupting the Solus approach lanes. Destroy the hostile patrol before it reaches local shipping.
rows.objective: Investigate raiders disrupting the Solus approach lanes. Destroy the hostile patrol before it reaches local shipping.

rows.description: Cover a loaded transport in Telmera. Defeat the attacking raiders while keeping the transport intact.

rows.description: Intercept a pirate strike flight assembling near Paragon. Destroy the flight before it can attack the local traffic corridor.

rows.name: Aram: Watch on the Border
rows.description: A missing Alliance reconnaissance ship has brought the carrier Archon into Aram. Hegemony Command considers this an armed incursion. Screen Orten while identifying and driving off the incoming Alliance patrol. Do not pursue the carrier beyond the border picket.
rows.objective: Protect Orten. Intercept Delta. Return safely.

rows.name: Loris: Wings of Iron
rows.description: Alliance strike package Condor is closing on the supply freighter Ascentia. Those holds sustain the Loris garrison. Break the bomber attack and keep the freighter intact; the Alliance escort is a secondary threat.
rows.objective: Protect Ascentia. Intercept Condor. Return safely.

rows.name: Tantalus: Hold the Line
rows.description: An Alliance strike is crossing the line above the Tantalus mining works. From the Hegemony side this is a raid on a working supply installation. Protect the station and intercept Alpha before its ordnance reaches the refinery.
rows.objective: Protect Tantalus Mining Station. Intercept Alpha. Return safely.

rows.name: Lornas: Deny the Hammer
rows.description: The carrier Archon has launched Mustang against our destroyer Sidus. Keep the strike fighters off the ship while Sidus withdraws under Orinoco's screen. Hegemony command needs this force intact for the Renser defense.
rows.objective: Protect Sidus. Intercept Mustang. Return safely.

rows.name: Shadow Canyon: Unbroken Shield
rows.description: Alliance flight Echo is attempting to suppress the defenses of Shadow Canyon. Hold the starbase perimeter, intercept the attackers and preserve the landing corridor for our returning crews.
rows.objective: Protect Starbase. Intercept Echo. Return safely.

rows.name: Paragon: Turn the Hunt
rows.description: Alliance cruisers Wraith and Nemesis are hunting our Paragon screen. Take command of the counterattack, protect Parthan and force the leading cruiser out of the approach lane. Neutral shipping is to be left alone.
rows.objective: Protect Parthan. Intercept Wraith. Return safely.

rows.name: Korius: The Other Sky
rows.description: Antares has committed a carrier group over Korius. Hegemony liaison command orders a fighter screen around Goliath while the allied Dantari force reorganizes. Contain the Alliance escort; the opposing carrier is not your primary target.
rows.objective: Protect Goliath. Intercept Antares. Return safely.

rows.name: Solus: Hold the Blockade
rows.description: Alliance forces have answered the Directorate appeal and Archon is entering the courier corridor. To the Separatist fleet this is foreign intervention. Support our blockade patrol and intercept the carrier's advancing fighter screen.
rows.objective: Protect Blockade Patrol. Intercept Avengers. Return safely.

rows.name: Solus: The Undelivered Order
rows.description: A Directorate courier carries orders intended to consolidate the failed coup's aftermath. Stop the military dispatch before it reaches the Alliance liaison. Expect Vanguard to protect the courier.
rows.objective: Protect Separatist Pursuit. Intercept Directorate Courier. Return safely.

rows.name: Kalon: Challenge at Harmony
rows.description: The Directorate is using Harmony Station to stage Alliance support. Escort Kalon Strike into the approach corridor and break the Avengers screen. Civilian berths are outside your engagement orders.
rows.objective: Protect Kalon Strike. Intercept Avengers. Return safely.

rows.name: Trellis: Close the Corridor
rows.description: Alliance fighters have opened a relief corridor at Trellis. Our command claims the same route is moving Directorate war supplies. Interdict the armed escort while our strike group inspects the shipping lane.
rows.objective: Protect Trellis Raiders. Intercept Avengers. Return safely.

rows.name: Renser: Eyes Beyond the Border
rows.description: Our Hegemony liaison reports an Alliance picket watching the Renser buildup. Cover the scouts as they recover their sensor records and disengage. This patrol is intelligence work, not an invasion of the picket line.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Scouts. Intercept Vanguard. Return safely.

rows.name: Meridian: The Observatory Screen
rows.description: The Directorate observatory at Tal Vesta is feeding tracking data to Alliance ships. Kendra and Pelorat are exposed to an approaching relief flight. Break its fighter screen and protect the Separatist ships; avoid the civilian research structures.
rows.objective: Protect Kendra. Intercept Vanguard. Return safely.

rows.name: Solus: Words and Weapons
rows.description: Accusations over Renser have hardened both fleets. Hold a defensive cordon around the liaison interceptors while the Alliance moves Stalwart into the area. Defeat the advance fighters and preserve our evidence relay.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Interceptors. Intercept Vanguard. Return safely.

rows.name: Trellis: A Dangerous Mandate
rows.description: The Senate resolution gives the Alliance a mandate we do not recognize. Escort our inspection group through the Trellis approach and challenge the armed escort. The relief transport itself is not a combat objective.
rows.objective: Protect Separatist Raiders. Intercept Vanguard. Return safely.

rows.name: Jalah: Bring Them Home
rows.description: The fleet is falling back to Jalah. Rear Guard must hold long enough for the scattered crews to return. Protect it from the Alliance fighter screen and keep the withdrawal route open.
rows.objective: Protect Separatist Rear Guard. Intercept Vanguard. Return safely.

rows.name: Khaital: The Price of Intervention
rows.description: Archon and Stalwart are pressing into Khaital. The Dantari liaison flight must protect Ironhelm and Mattock while the defensive force reforms. Defeat the carrier's fighter screen without abandoning the withdrawal line.
rows.objective: Protect Ironhelm. Intercept Vanguard. Return safely.

rows.name: Solus: Seal the Dispatch
rows.description: A Directorate courier is trying to carry emergency orders through our allied patrol. Escort Separatist Pursuit into position and break Vanguard's escort screen. Preserve the liaison ships; do not chase the courier into civilian traffic.
rows.objective: Protect Separatist Pursuit. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Renser: Forward Eyes
rows.description: Our scouts have detected an Alliance picket watching the Renser approaches. Protect Hegemony Scouts while their records are relayed to command. Intercept Vanguard before it can fix our withdrawal vector.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Scouts. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Solus: Shield the Liaison
rows.description: The accusations over Renser are bringing Stalwart forward. Our liaison interceptors must remain on station long enough to confirm the fleet movement. Screen them against Vanguard and keep a route clear for recovery.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Interceptors. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Trellis: Armed Passage
rows.description: Alliance fighters are escorting a transport through the Trellis cordon. Protect our inspection flight and challenge the armed escort. Relief passengers and civilian crews are outside your engagement orders.
rows.objective: Protect Separatist Raiders. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Jalah: Cover the Withdrawal
rows.description: The Dantari force is falling back toward Jalah. Hegemony liaison command has committed your flight to cover Separatist Rear Guard. Stop Vanguard from disrupting the withdrawal and bring our crews home.
rows.objective: Protect Separatist Rear Guard. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Kalon: Challenge the Screen
rows.description: Harmony Station has become an anchor for Alliance support. Escort Kalon Strike into the approach lane, defeat Avengers and preserve the strike group. Civilian berths remain protected.
rows.objective: Protect Kalon Strike. Intercept Avengers. Recover safely.

rows.name: Solus: Hold the Cordon
rows.description: Archon is advancing into Solus behind an Alliance fighter screen. Protect Blockade Patrol and intercept Avengers before the cordon is scattered. The carrier itself is not your flight's objective.
rows.objective: Protect Blockade Patrol. Intercept Avengers. Recover safely.

rows.name: Khaital: Ironhelm Relief
rows.description: Archon and Stalwart are pressing our Khaital line. Ironhelm needs time to regroup under Mattock's cover. Break Vanguard's advance and keep the defensive group intact.
rows.objective: Protect Ironhelm. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Meridian: Rescue the Screen
rows.description: Kendra is exposed near the Tal Vesta observatory as Alliance relief fighters arrive. Cover the ship and defeat Vanguard. Your orders concern the armed escort, not the civilian research complex.
rows.objective: Protect Kendra. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Trellis: Close the Breach
rows.description: The Alliance has opened a passage through the Trellis approaches. Support our patrol while it reforms the cordon, and defeat Avengers before they can widen the breach. Neutral vessels are to be left clear.
rows.objective: Protect Trellis Raiders. Intercept Avengers. Recover safely.

rows.name: Janek: Forward Spear
rows.description: The first Hegemony formations are reaching Janek. Cover Hegemony Vanguard while it establishes a reliable picture of the Alliance defenses. Intercept Vanguard's fighters and preserve our forward force.
rows.sitrep: The Janek forward screen is exposed while our spearhead reforms. Defend the picket, destroy the Alliance interception flight and recover before our carriers shift station. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Vanguard and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Vanguard. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Borova: Hold the Approach
rows.description: The Alliance withdrawal has left a crowded approach lane over Borova. Keep our pursuit flight together and defeat the armed Vanguard escort. Evacuation transports are not authorized targets.
rows.sitrep: Borova is the hinge of the advance. Hold the approach against an Alliance counterattack while the forward wing refuels; preserve the assigned defense flight. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Pursuit and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Pursuit. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Borova: Turn the Counterstroke
rows.description: Survivors of Titan's group are withdrawing behind an Alliance fighter screen. Cover Hegemony Pursuit against the counterattack. Do not let the pursuit separate our own crews from their recovery corridor.
rows.sitrep: Alliance scouts have located our Borova staging lane. Break the counterstroke and protect the ships forming the next sortie. Do not chase beyond the recovery corridor. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Pursuit and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Pursuit. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Borova: Diplomatic Cordon
rows.description: Diplomatic traffic is crossing the combat zone. Protect our interceptors while they enforce the military cordon, and defeat the armed Vanguard patrol. The diplomatic transport must remain outside your fire.
rows.sitrep: Diplomatic traffic is crossing the contested Borova perimeter. Keep armed Alliance interceptors away from the protected liaison unit. Civilian traffic is not a target. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Interceptors. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Pallas: Hold the Spearhead
rows.description: The Alliance destroyer screen is contesting the Athenar approach. Protect our supporting force at Pallas and break Vanguard's fighter attack. Keep our ships available for the next advance.
rows.sitrep: The Pallas spearhead is isolated from its escorts. Clear the Alliance fighter screen, keep the marked Hegemony unit alive and recover to the carrier. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Fighters and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Fighters. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Borova: Rearguard Vigil
rows.description: Alliance reconstruction traffic has moved into the contested orbit. Our rear guard must disengage before Vanguard pins it down. Cover the withdrawal and leave the unarmed reconstruction crews alone.
rows.sitrep: A rear guard is buying time for the Borova withdrawal. Intercept the pursuing Alliance flights and prevent them from overrunning the protected element. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Rear Guard and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Rear Guard. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Silessia: A Clear Corridor
rows.description: Far Horizon is crossing a dangerous military corridor. Keep Hegemony Interceptors clear of the Alliance fighter screen while the neutral colony ship passes. Its passengers are not part of this war.
rows.sitrep: Our Silessia passage is threatened by Alliance reconnaissance flights. Clear the corridor while the marked unit crosses, then return rather than pursuing into another sector. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Interceptors. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Vesta: No Safe Harbor
rows.description: Brotherhood raiders are exploiting the fighting around Vesta. Escort Hegemony Supply Tender, destroy the pirate flight and keep our supply route open. Nearby civilian transports are not targets.
rows.sitrep: Brotherhood raiders are exploiting the Vesta withdrawal. Defeat the pirate screen and protect the assigned Hegemony unit. This is a recovery action, not an attack on civilian shipping. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Supply Tender. Intercept Brotherhood Raiders. Recover safely.

rows.name: Aram: Outpost Relief
rows.description: The Sixth Fleet is probing the Aram outpost ahead of an invasion of Tarsus. Protect Outpost Patrol and defeat Vanguard before the picket can isolate our defenders.
rows.sitrep: Aram outpost requests immediate relief. Protect its local defense force and stop the Alliance interception flight before it can pin down the relief ships. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Outpost Patrol and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Outpost Patrol. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Tarsus: The Ambassador's Wake
rows.description: Alliance diplomatic traffic is moving through Tarsus under fighter escort. Keep our interceptors intact while command assesses the delegation. Engage Vanguard, and leave the diplomatic transport unharmed.
rows.sitrep: The ambassador route through Tarsus is compromised. Defend the liaison element against armed interceptors and keep the recovery lane clear. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Rogue Interceptors and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Rogue Interceptors. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Tarsus: An Unwelcome Ally
rows.description: A Zolon strike flight is attacking ships in the Tarsus approaches. Protect Hegemony Supply Tender and defeat the third-party attackers. Their hostility toward the Alliance does not make them friends of the Hegemony.
rows.sitrep: Unknown Zolon craft have entered the Tarsus engagement. Prioritize the alien attackers threatening the protected unit. Do not treat this as another routine Alliance patrol. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Supply Tender. Intercept Zolon Strike Flight. Recover safely.

rows.name: Loris: Lifeline Under Fire
rows.description: The collapse of the Loris front has exposed supply traffic to the Brotherhood. Escort Hegemony Supply Tender through the lane and destroy the raiders before they can turn the withdrawal into a rout.
rows.sitrep: Loris supply tenders are exposed during the retreat. Escort the protected tender through the marked lane and destroy Brotherhood raiders before they reach it. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Supply Tender and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Supply Tender. Intercept Brotherhood Raiders. Recover safely.

rows.name: Kolchev: Preserve the Picket
rows.description: The Sixth Fleet has reached Kolchev. Protect Hegemony Interceptors while our fleet picket reforms, and stop Vanguard from fixing the ships in place for a follow-on strike.
rows.sitrep: The Kolchev picket must survive to warn the next defensive line. Defend the marked interceptors, defeat the Alliance screen and recover without sacrificing the picket. Your assigned craft is Raptor. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Interceptors. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Garrison: Night Watch
rows.description: Alliance carrier forces are entering the Garrison approaches. Cover Hegemony Picket and break Vanguard's advance fighters. Every surviving flight is needed for the defense of the homeward routes.
rows.sitrep: Zolon probes have appeared near Garrison. Defend the Hegemony picket and destroy the alien scouts before they fix the recovery route. The Zolons are the enemy; you remain a Hegemony pilot. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Picket and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Picket. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Radix: Crossroads Guard
rows.description: Radix controls the routes between the forward front and our remaining bases. Protect Hegemony Interceptors and defeat the Alliance fighter screen before it can sever the crossing.
rows.sitrep: Zolon strike craft are crossing Radix. Protect the interceptor screen holding the junction and stop the alien attack before it cuts our withdrawal route. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Interceptors and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Interceptors. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Ramek: Keep the Bay Open
rows.description: Alliance cruisers are suppressing the Ramek defenses. Cover Ramek Defense Wing against Vanguard and preserve the recovery lane. Our damaged crews need a bay they can still reach.
rows.sitrep: Alien attackers are closing on Ramek. Keep the defense wing alive and the bay approach clear so damaged crews can recover. Break the Zolon attack and return to the carrier. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Ramek Defense Wing and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Ramek Defense Wing. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Garrison: Last Laboratory Guard
rows.description: An Alliance strike is closing on Garrison Military Laboratory. Keep its defenses intact and intercept Vanguard before the cruisers complete their attack. Hold only as long as our crews need to recover.
rows.sitrep: Zolon forces threaten Garrison Military Laboratory during the evacuation of its technical staff. Defend the facility and defeat the alien strike screen; no attack on neutral rescuers is authorized. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Garrison Military Laboratory and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Garrison Military Laboratory. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.

rows.name: Volante: The Rear Guard
rows.description: The Alliance has reached the Volante approaches. Protect Hegemony Rear Guard while Vendetta covers the final withdrawal. Break the Vanguard screen and keep a route open for the ships behind you.
rows.sitrep: The Zolon pursuit has reached Volante. Protect the Hegemony rear guard, destroy the pursuing alien flights and preserve the final recovery corridor for surviving crews. Your assigned craft is Avenger. Destroy the marked hostile flights, preserve Hegemony Rear Guard and recover to your carrier.
rows.objective: Protect Hegemony Rear Guard. Intercept Vanguard. Recover safely.
